$comment: Emits the Host half: lib/index.js plus declarations under lib/types/.
The browser half is built separately by tsdown (see tsdown.config.ts) and
lands at lib/client.js — the path package.json exports['./client'] points
at, which the dsh client module system resolves and reads off disk.
The client half is excluded here: it targets the browser, has no Node
entry, and is bundled by the tsdown config with the lazy-CJS factory
wrapper the client module system requires.
